summary: Colville National Forest lookout on Twin Sisters: a 30-foot timber tower built in 1966 and gone by 1975; footings noted in 2011; old site reached by a jeep trail.

facts.design: 30-foot treated timber tower with an R-6 flat cab
facts.status_note: Gone by 1975; a 2011 visit found footings and views remained; no source describes a standing structure today

access.note: Forest Service jeep route #109, open April 1 to November 30; no closure mentioned; trail only periodically cleared

visit.trail_note: Turnoff north about 0.97 miles to a parking area below the peak; the Forest Service asks visitors not to drive to the top because of nails on the ground and says to hike the rest

notes_for_editor: Dates (1966 built, gone by 1975) agree across three sources. Today's condition rests on the 2011 visit report and the Forest Service route page, which describes the old site as a viewpoint but says nothing about footings now. Staffing and fires: nothing in the sources read. The weebly Twin Sisters page only yielded its index, so its content was not used. A search hit for an NPS PDF on a Twin Sisters Peak lookout was not used; it does not match this Ferry County site. Brief's firelookout URL was http; the https version was fetched. Brief's access 'unknown' is now public.
